Innovation – Wir denken lieber „Warum eigentlich nicht?“ statt „Das war schon immer so.“ Wir lieben neue

title: Closer

description: Chez nous, vendre, c'est coacher à la décision. 🎯 Nous sommes convaincus de trois choses : Vous êtes là pour sincèrement aider la personne en face de vous. Même si c'est inconfortable. 💡 Parfois, votre rôle sera simplement de provoquer une prise de conscience et de les laisser partir. D'autres fois, il faudra aller plus loin pour les aider à regarder la réalité en face. Toujours avec la même intention : faire ce qui est le mieux pour eux. Notre objectif n’est pas de faire une formation de plus, mais de développer un nouveau standard dans notre domaine. Nous avons construit un produit exceptionnel, qui permet à nos élèves d'obtenir des transformations que beaucoup pensent impossibles. Et plutôt que de vous demander de nous croire sur parole, voici quelques témoignages de nos élèves : 🎥 Barman → Data Analyst : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yTFLTspkOGc BAC+2 → Data Analyst : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jkiycuwroAo Fonctionnaire → Data Analyst (en 8 mois avec famille et boulot en // ) : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oTGsn3x391Y Marketing → Data Project Manager : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lQG_-yspImU Jonathan - Retour après avoir fait des bootcamps pendant 4 ans : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qZqLoWP1RwA Nous sommes une petite équipe de passionnés, curieux, exigeants avec nous-mêmes, qui aiment le travail bien fait et cherchent constamment à s'améliorer. Nous grandissons et aujourd’hui, nous recherchons un Closer qui souhaite construire avec nous sur le long terme. Votre mission 🤝 Nos prospects prennent une décision importante : changer de métier. Votre rôle est de comprendre leur situation, de leur apporter les connaissances et les perspectives nécessaires, et de les aider à prendre une décision éclairée. Cela demande de savoir écouter, expliquer, rassurer et parfois confronter leurs idées. Concrètement : Mener des entretiens de vente avec des prospects qualifiés. Comprendre leurs motivations, leurs freins et leurs objectifs. Présenter notre accompagnement avec pédagogie. Assurer le suivi commercial et le reporting quotidien. Respect de nos process : les leads qualifiés le sont. Participer aux trainings d’équipe pour progresser continuellement. Conditions 📋 Statut : Freelance / Indépendant Lieu : 100% télétravail, d'où vous voulez 🌎 Disponibilité : minimum 15h par semaine, dont 10h de calls commerciaux Rémunération : discutée après qualification de votre candidature. Ce qui compte pour nous, ce sont les résultats, pas les heures travaillées. Vous êtes libre de vous organiser comme vous le souhaitez. En contrepartie, nous attendons de la fiabilité : tenir vos engagements et être présent dans les moments importants. Nous voulons être les meilleurs et gagner, mais jamais au détriment de notre santé, de notre famille ou de notre vie personnelle. Le profil recherché 🌟 Amoureux de la psychologie humaine : vous aimez comprendre les gens, leurs motivations, leurs peurs et leurs comportements. Intelligence émotionnelle : vous savez écouter, faire preuve d'empathie et confronter avec bienveillance. Communication : vous vous exprimez avec clarté, précision et impact. Ouvert au feedback (essentiel) : vous aimez apprendre, remettre en question vos méthodes et progresser. Autonome et fiable : vous savez vous organiser et prendre vos responsabilités. You earn trust fast, ask the right questions, and turn a customer's goals into a plan that actually sticks. If that sounds like you, keep reading. We'd love to meet you. As a Customer Success Manager at Klue, you own the full customer relationship, from onboarding through renewal and expansion. You're the connective tissue: keeping every account team aligned, every customer growing, and every risk on the radar before it becomes a problem. Klue's product moves fast. New AI agents, integrations, and capabilities ship continuously. The CSMs who thrive here stay ahead of it, act on signals early, and show up as both a trusted advisor and a confident commercial partner. Your Mission? To make sure every customer in your book gets real, measurable value from Klue, and grows because of it. You build the relationships, drive the adoption, and close the commercial outcomes. When your customers win, you win. What's In It for You? This role puts you at the center of how B2B companies use competitive intelligence to win deals, grow revenue, and own their markets. You'll work across industries and stakeholder levels, build deep customer intuition, and gain hard-won experience running complex change management inside leading organizations. In an AI-first company shipping continuously, your expertise compounds fast. No two years here look the same. What You'll Do Own Renewals and Expansions. Your book, your number. You forecast it, manage it, and hit it. That means spotting churn signals before anyone else names them, building the business case for expansion, and running cross-sell motions with Sales, including Klue's win-loss interview program. The commercial outcomes are yours. Drive Adoption and Platform Completeness. Klue ships fast. Your job is to make sure every customer keeps up: AI agents running, integrations live, Curators and Consumers actually using the platform. You stay current on what's new and make it land, translating product velocity into conversations your customers care about. Map Outcomes and Demonstrate ROI. You connect Klue to what your customers actually care about: win rate, rep confidence, PMM efficiency. You quantify it, document it, and make it impossible to argue with at renewal time. ROI isn't a slide you build at the end, it's a story you're telling all year. Multi-Thread and Lead Change. Single-threaded accounts are at-risk accounts. You build across levels by default: economic buyers, Champions, Consumers, exec sponsors. You help customers navigate their own organizations and drive adoption through real friction, not around it. Lead the Account Team. You own the account, which means owning the strategy and everyone working inside it. Win-Loss Researchers, PMAs, Sales, AI Solutions. You set the direction. They execute alongside you. What Success Looks Like We want you to love the role you're in and believe these are the things that matter most. You'll know you're nailing it when: GRR and expansion targets are met or exceeded for your book every quarter. All eligible customers have their AI agents running: right competitors tracked, right integrations live, platform usage above benchmarks. Upsell and cross-sell opportunities are identified, qualified, and closed at or above target. Win-loss cross-sell pipeline exists and is actively moving for eligible accounts. Every account has at least one documented ROI moment per quarter, tied to a specific Klue outcome. Every account has at least two active contacts at different levels. No single-threaded accounts in your book. Customers are activated on new product capabilities within one quarter of release. Risk is flagged and acted on early, not discovered at renewal. title: Customer Support Manager
description: About Us Hozah is a tech-led, award-winning company driving change in the parking industry and reimagining urban mobility. Our mission is simple but powerful: to transform parking into a seamless, automated experience, paving the way for smarter, more sustainable cities. We run camera-based parking for landowners and operators, from hotels and colleges to shopping centres, across England, Scotland and Wales. With recent recognition as PayTech Company of the Year, a place among Deloitte’s Top 50 Fastest Growing Tech Companies in the UK, and significant VC/PE investment, we’re one of the fastest scaling companies in the country. Role Overview We’re looking for a Customer Support Manager to lead our support team: six people across two desks, handling around 1,500 tickets a week. One desk helps the landowners and asset managers we work with; the other helps the drivers who park at their sites. This isn’t answering from an FAQ. Many tickets mean investigating across our systems, escalating to TechOps and following up until the problem is fixed. It’s a role for someone who enjoys making a team better. You’ll have the freedom to bring your own ideas, the backing of our COO, and Client Success, TechOps and Product teams to work with on them. You’ll make the case for what the team needs and be hands-on with our helpdesk tools to get there. You’ll lead from the front too, getting stuck into tickets with the team when it’s busy. Key Responsibilities Lead, coach and develop a team of six, with regular one-to-ones and clear standards for quality and output. Run the day-to-day across both desks, keeping response times, resolution and the backlog on track. Get stuck in on tickets when the queue is busy, and handle the trickier escalations yourself. Spot what drivers and clients keep contacting us about, and work with other teams to fix the cause. Get the most out of Zendesk, from macros and tagging to reporting. Plan the rota, including Saturday cover, around leave and busy periods. Who we’re looking for You’ll need: Experience leading a customer support or service team, ideally on an email or ticket-based desk with targets. A track record of improving how a team performs. Experience setting clear targets, holding people to them and coaching them to get there. Comfortable with Zendesk or a similar tool, and with using data to see what’s going on. Happy getting into the detail of a problem, across systems and teams, to find out what actually went wrong. Curiosity about how automation and AI could make the team’s work easier. Clear, calm writing, even when a customer isn’t, and confidence on the phone with an unhappy client. Nice to have: Experience in parking, mobility, utilities or another high-volume consumer service. Experience setting up weekend cover. What We Offer £35,000, negotiable Hybrid working: 3 days in the office, 2 days from home. Room to grow with the business, with training and development support. 20 days’ annual leave plus bank holidays. Company pension scheme. A fully refurbished, modern office right next to East Croydon Station, with a fully stocked kitchen offering free breakfast, lunch and drinks (and two office dogs!). Laptop and tech provided. Employee Assistance Programme, BrightHR Exchange discounts and regular company events. The details Location: Croydon, next to East Croydon Station. Hybrid: 3 days in the office, 2 from home. Reports to: Daivik Patel, Chief Operating Officer. Team: 6 support agents across two desks (Client Service and Driver Support). title: Senior Underwriting Analyst, Quality Control
description: Company Description We’re Checkout.com . You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day. We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers. Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale. If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact. With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started. Role purpose The Senior Analyst, Underwriting Quality Control (QC) will establish and continually improve a consistent, risk-based quality control framework for work completed by Underwriters. The role will build on existing QC practices and tools, tailoring them to the Underwriting lifecycle, products, risk decisions and operating model. The role provides an objective, evidence-led check that underwriting assessments and outcomes are complete, consistent, appropriately documented and aligned with internal policy, procedures and applicable requirements. It will turn review results into clear management information, actionable feedback, targeted training and measurable improvements in underwriting quality. This is a hands-on role. The Senior Analyst will conduct QC reviews, maintain the framework and reporting, follow findings through to verified remediation, and work with Underwriters and leaders to address recurring gaps. description: The Practical Detail Location: Hybrid | Remote Why this role matters In your first year, you will deliver an ambitious growth plan for Flora Food Group's largest customer, Bidfood, driving both sales and margin across the full P&L. This role is critical to strengthening Flora's position in the food service market by embedding a joint business plan that aligns Flora's brand priorities with Bidfood's commercial strategy. You will shape how our brands are listed, promoted, and grow within a key account that influences menus and food trends across the UK. Your work will directly impact the availability and innovation of better food in kitchens nationwide. What you'll do Own the Bidfood P&L, managing pricing, promotions, trade spend, and trade promotion management accruals to achieve sales and margin growth. Lead the joint business plan and negotiate annual trading terms to ensure Flora's brands are well positioned and invested in. Build and maintain relationships across all levels of Bidfood, from senior buyers to depot and logistics teams, to improve service and unlock commercial opportunities. Deliver new product development and innovation launches on time and at the right price, collaborating closely with culinary and new business teams. Champion the push-pull strategy by engaging Bidfood's end users—contract caterers, pubs, hotels, restaurants and Quick Serve Restaurants (QSR) — to grow brand presence and volume. Performance You will own the full P&L for the Bidfood account, driving measurable growth in sales and margin while managing trade spend within budget. Your leadership of the joint business plan will ensure alignment between Flora's brand ambitions and Bidfood's commercial goals. Success will be seen in improved brand listings, timely innovation launches, and strong trading terms that support sustainable growth. Care You will report directly to Helen Scott and collaborate with internal teams including new business, culinary, supply chain, and demand planning to ensure seamless service delivery. Externally, you will engage with multiple Bidfood functions such as buying, logistics, marketing, and category teams. Your decisions will balance commercial ambition with operational integrity, supporting a lean team environment during a period of organisational change. Passion Bidfood is at the heart of food service trends, where culinary culture is shaped. You will connect Flora's innovation pipeline directly to the chefs and kitchens that bring our products to life. Your role will influence how plant-based, indulgent, and culinary food categories evolve in the out-of-home market. Your curiosity about taste, nutrition, and functionality will drive meaningful innovation and brand growth. About you You'll bring solid food service experience, ideally managing Bidfood, Brakes, or Booker accounts, with a deep understanding of this route to market. You are commercially rigorous, confident in owning a P&L, and skilled at negotiating assertively while maintaining productive relationships. You sell on brand value, not price, and thrive in a fast-changing, lean environment. Your resilience and solution-oriented mindset help you navigate complex commercial and cultural challenges. You are genuinely interested in food culture and curious about how consumer behaviour and future food trends shape innovation. You understand that strong brands are built by anticipating what's next in taste, nutrition, and functionality, and by translating insight into meaningful consumer experiences. Where this could lead to This role typically leads to broader commercial leadership opportunities within Flora Food Group, including potential European roles as the business integrates into a larger unit. There is also scope to move into retail or new business functions. With success, you may take on direct reports and progress into senior management positions within 2 to 3 years. Le rôle En tant que Customer Success Manager Key Accounts (CSM KA), tu accompagnes un portefeuille de cabinets partenaires grands comptes (7 à 10 comptes, Top 150) qui déploient Pennylane auprès de leurs équipes et de leurs clients. Ton objectif : maximiser l’adoption, la satisfaction et la rétention, tout en structurant une gouvernance adaptée à des organisations multi-bureaux. Construire et animer la gouvernance : COPIL, comités d’adoption, instances de suivi, communauté de relais locaux. Anticiper les risques (satisfaction, déploiement, adoption) et mettre en place des plans de remédiation. Contribuer à l’inscription et à l’usage de la PA Pennylane pour centraliser les flux. Suivre l’exécution post-déploiement et proposer des actions correctives. 2) Adoption et usage côté collaborateurs Mesurer l’usage et identifier les leviers d’amélioration. Mettre en place des plans d’action et en piloter l’exécution. 3) Satisfaction & rétention Maintenir une relation de confiance, cadrer les attentes et délivrer de la valeur. Déployer des plans d’action stratégiques (annuels / semestriels) avec les partenaires. Indicateurs de réussite CSAT sur ton portefeuille. Progression de l’adoption (collaborateurs et clients), suivie en COPIL. Qualité de la gouvernance et autonomie des relais locaux. Réduction des risques et amélioration de la rétention. title: Senior Systems Engineer - Autonomy Behavior
description: Description Senior Systems Engineer - Autonomy Behavior The Role As a Senior Autonomy Behavior Systems Engineer, you will help define and validate how an autonomous vehicle behaves in the real world. You will own one or more behavior areas from requirements through simulation evaluation, road-data review, and release recommendation. This role sits at the intersection of systems engineering, software validation, simulation, and safety. You will turn broad product and safety goals into clear behavior definitions, testable requirements, metrics, test plans, and evidence. You will also need to understand what the results mean, where they are weak, and what should happen next. What You'll Do Own end-to-end validation for one or more autonomous driving behaviors, from initial behavior scoping and requirements definition to product launch. Combine simulation, road data, closed-course testing, and expert review to evaluate behavior across large scenario sets, diverse conditions, software versions, and fleet configurations. Define, deploy, and refine metrics, test strategies and acceptance criteria for autonomous behavior for simulation and road. Partner with teams across and outside the autonomy organization to assess, author, and present behavior readiness for release and launch decisions. Required Qualifications Master's degree in systems engineering, mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, electrical engineering, computer science, robotics, or a related field. 5 or more years of professional experience in systems engineering, autonomous vehicles, robotics, simulation, or safety-critical validation. Proven experience evaluating autonomous vehicles in support of a self-driving fleet launch. Strong understanding of systems engineering fundamentals, including system decomposition, use-case definition, requirements authoring, interface definition, verification planning, and traceability. Professional experience designing or executing simulation-based evaluations at scale, not just isolated scenario demonstrations. Strong Python experience for data analysis, test automation, simulation workflows, and engineering tools and exposure to agentic workflows. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of working effectively across teams. Demonstrated ability to manage stakeholders, resolve ambiguity, set expectations, and drive work to completion without waiting for a perfect process. What Will Give You a Competitive Edge Experience with human benchmarking for behavioral or safety evaluation, including attentive human benchmark data, human percentiles, or expert labeling. Experience with counterfactual analysis in simulation, including comparing an autonomous vehicle response with a human or alternate-system response under the same scene conditions. Familiarity with safety cases, safety claims, and the role of validation evidence in supporting them. Experience with hazard analysis, including structured hazard analysis, scenario-based hazard analysis, failure analysis, or similar methods. Understanding of risk quantification, risk acceptance, risk budgets, and mitigation prioritization. Experience translating legal or regulatory expectations into behavioral requirements, metrics, test coverage, or compliance evidence. Experience with large scenario libraries, synthetic test generation, replay-to-simulation workflows, simulation test protocols, or validation scorecards.
